facts.statement: SOE ran a 'Wiki Wednesday' feature that highlighted new dresses and invited players to contribute photos and videos to the Official Free Realms Wiki.
facts.quote: Add your own photos, if you like! You can even add videos to show off each dress in action.

article_summaries.title: Wiki Wednesday: Dresses
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com 'What is New?' news post announcing that three new dresses (Simple Dress, Pockets Dress, Skulls Dress) were introduced to Free Realms, and asking players to add photos and videos of them to the official Free Realms Wiki. The exact posting date is not given; the page says only 'Posted 2 months, 5 days ago' relative to capture, and no prices, stats or acquisition methods are stated.
